label: Bible Study
prompt: For it is God which _____ in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
verse: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
note: Right after 'work out your own salvation' — Paul says it's God doing the work within.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Fear not, O land; be _____ and rejoice: for the LORD will do great things.
verse: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the LORD will do great things.
note: After the locust plague, Joel turns it around: fear not, O land — be glad, the LORD will do great things.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Moses said, I will now turn _____, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
verse: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
note: Moses' curiosity started it all: he turned aside to look, and God spoke from the bush (Exodus 3:4).

label: Deep Water
prompt: Now therefore give me this _____, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the LORD will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.
verse: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the LORD will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.
note: Caleb at 85 asks for the hardest hill country, giants included — the faithful spy hadn't retired.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of _____ toward God, and toward men.
verse: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men.
note: Paul before Felix: his daily exercise is a conscience 'void of offence' — British spelling, with a c.
